suabilities.e: That case, and others in this court relating to the suability of States, proceeded upon the broad ground that it is inherent in the nature of sovereignty not to be amenable to the suit of an individual without its consent.

suability.e: That case, and others in this court relating to the suability of States, proceeded upon the broad ground that it is inherent in the nature of sovereignty not to be amenable to the suit of an individual without its consent.

suasion.m: The act of persuading (or attempting to persuade); communication intended to induce belief or action.

suavely.e: He is suavely charming and all the ladies love him.
suavely.m: With suavity; in a suave manner.

suaveness.m: The quality of being bland and gracious or ingratiating in manner.

suavity.m: The quality of being bland and gracious or ingratiating in manner.
